title: Luscious Creamy Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A kid-friendly Mediterranean dish featuring lamb kebabs with a creamy plum sauce, perfect for a family dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together plum sauce, yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
Transfer the kebabs to a serving platter and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot with additional plum sauce for dipping.
